notes:
{掘削|くっさく} refers to drilling or excavating into the ground, commonly used in construction, tunneling, and resource extraction contexts.

WRITING:
- {掘|くつ} (dig)
- {削|さく} (shave, scrape, cut)

USAGE:
- {掘削|くっさく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to drill, to excavate - suru verb)
- {掘削|くっさく}{機|き} (drilling/excavation machine)
- {掘削|くっさく}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ (excavation work)

COMMON APPLICATIONS:
- ⟦{井戸|いど}→井戸：03977_ido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{掘削|くっさく} (well drilling)
- {油田|ゆでん}{掘削|くっさく} (oil field drilling)
- ⟦トンネル→トンネル：03865_tonneru⟧{掘削|くっさく} (tunnel excavation)
- ⟦{地盤|じばん}→地盤：04035_jiban⟧{掘削|くっさく} (ground excavation)

TECHNICAL EQUIPMENT:
- {掘削|くっさく}{機|き} (drilling machine)
- {掘削|くっさく}リグ (drilling rig)
- シールド{掘削|くっさく}{機|き} (shield tunneling machine)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発掘|はっくつ}→発掘：07995_hakkutsu⟧ - archaeological excavation/discovery
- ⟦{採掘|さいくつ}→採掘：07996_saikutsu⟧ - mining for resources
- {掘削|くっさく} - drilling/boring (mechanical excavation)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{発掘|はっくつ}→発掘：07995_hakkutsu⟧ (excavation - archaeological)
- ⟦{採掘|さいくつ}→採掘：07996_saikutsu⟧ (mining, extraction)
- {穿孔|せんこう} (boring, drilling)
- ⟦{掘|ほ}る→掘る：00442_horu⟧ (to dig - basic verb)
